Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Mr. Segrave moved to amend by substitute
map dated September 11, 2023, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion to amend carried by unanimous
voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Lonnie Olson, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Casey Palma,
Palma Land Planning, was available for questions. Committee members Rinne and Segrave
commented on the item.

24, RESOLUTION - Expressing the support of the Governing Body for the designation of the
High Plains Arboretum as a State Historic Site by the Wyoming State Legislature.
(SPONSOR— DR. RINNE)

Dr. Rinne moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Stefanie Boster, City Attomey, provided a staff report and Nick Neylon, Wyoming State Parks
Deputy Director, was available for questions.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:44 p.m.
